## Repository

[{{REPO}}](https://github.com/{{REPO}})

## Sprint

- 1 week (7 days), starting Monday
- Change this to fit your team, and set the same length and start day in the Sprint field settings

## Views

Views marked ☆ show what the Scrum Guide requires.

### Product Backlog ☆

- Open issues labeled `enhancement` or `bug`
- Ordered by the Product Owner

### Technical Backlog

- Open issues labeled `documentation` or `devex`
- Part of the Product Backlog whose ordering the Product Owner delegates to the Developers

### Sprint Backlog ☆

- Items in the current Sprint

### Goals ☆

- The Product Goal and Sprint Goals (issues labeled `product-goal` / `sprint`)

### Roadmap

- PBIs on a timeline by Sprint

### Increment Log

- Completed PBIs. Not the Increment itself, so no ☆

### Draft issues

- Draft items not yet turned into issues

### Closed (Other)

- Items closed without being completed
